name: catalyst_retrieval_capability_scorecard_v1
principle: Use task-matched metrics. TPS-specific small candidate universes use practical fixed-budget Hit@K/hidden-positive recall; general large candidate universes use candidate-fraction success plus MRR. Never compare raw percentages across different candidate universes as if they were the same task.

metric_map.Production: runtime, memory, deterministic ranking, retention; never conflate with retrieval accuracy

presentation_rules: Do not compare raw Hit@K between TPS-small and general-large candidate universes as a single leaderboard.
Show exploitation and exploration side by side; low strict-double-cold absolute scores do not invalidate high practical TPS completion scores.
For general large-universe retrieval, normalized candidate-fraction success is preferred because it measures screening compression consistently across directions.
Any best-of-seed table remains presentation-only and all seeds are retained; the full scorecard above uses full available evaluation rows unless otherwise stated.
